requirements.text: Freeze execution against the actual simple-chats start commit and record drift from the reviewed head.
Reconcile the predecessor UI-refactor status, checksums, ignored proof paths, and closure claims before dependent work.
Record the user-provided manual regression evidence without overstating untested scenarios.
Do not activate any Simple Chat browser surface before the mandatory CP1 hardening checkpoint passes.
Preserve the currently proven Agent settings, main chat, floating chat, Process chat, and Project Structure context behavior.
Make reusable presentation collections defensive immutable snapshots rather than caller-owned IReadOnlyList references.
Normalize and bound ConversationPresentationKey values while preserving existing agent key round-trips.
Replace hard-coded active-item Open/Stop semantics with source-neutral declared action descriptors.
Map existing Agent active-chat Open and Stop actions through the generic action contract with unchanged behavior and accessibility.
Allow the transcript to render a bounded collection of transient messages rather than one user-specific pending message.
Derive message alignment, avatar, color, copy behavior, and role label from message role, not from transient state.
Support a transient streaming Assistant message that can grow incrementally without becoming canonical transcript state.
Represent Pending, Streaming, Failed, and Cancelled display states with explicit status text and accessibility semantics.
Never persist or append partial streamed text as a canonical assistant transcript entry from the UI.
Continue to disable raw HTML in rendered conversation Markdown.
Neutralize unsafe Markdown link and image URI schemes and prove safe relative, fragment, http, https, and mailto behavior.
Preserve existing Agent hidden-context parsing, approvals, execution, voice, attachments, token metadata, copy, focus, and auto-scroll behavior.
Expose the exact active operation identity in conversation engine/application state when an active turn exists.
Propagate ActiveOperationId through internal details and the additive HTTP conversation response without exposing system prompt content.
Keep ActiveOperationId profile-fenced and prove it cannot reference another conversation or database-profile generation.
Use the existing application-level LlmChatOperationEventStreamSession boundary as the durable event source.
Do not implement the server-side Blazor UI by making loopback HTTP/SSE calls to its own Web host.
On replay retention gaps or invalid local cursors, discard transient partial output and refresh authoritative operation/transcript state.
Disposing, hiding, navigating away from, or disconnecting a UI follower must not cancel the durable LLM operation.
Cancellation must occur only through the explicit operation-cancel command and remain distinct from window close or archive.
Create a dedicated CanDoItAll.Modules.LlmChats.Ui Razor project for product UI and presentation mapping.
Keep the Simple Chat UI project free of EF Core, Persistence, Web API DTO, AgentFramework Core, tools, skills, voice, and agent execution references.
Register the UI module, Razor assembly, and required services only through focused composition extensions and assembly markers.
Gate read, manage, and execute UI actions with authorization semantics aligned to the existing LLM Chat API policies.
Expose route and shell navigation only after definitions, conversations, and operation lifecycle behavior are functionally proven.
Use one explicit large-desktop scroll owner and preserve the application first-viewport composition at 1600x1000 or maximized desktop.
List and filter Simple Chat definitions across Draft, Active, Suspended, and Archived states.
Create and edit definition name, avatar, summary, system prompt, and revision reason through reusable editor components.
Edit tags and preserve definition identity/revision metadata without adding deployment-owned fields.
Load provider/model choices through ILlmChatProviderResolver and keep provider SDK types out of the UI boundary.
Edit temperature, supported thinking effort, and timeout with provider/model capability-aware validation.
Expose Text, JSON, and JSON Schema response-format settings in an explicit advanced section.
Honor concurrency tokens, immutable revisions, status transitions, and reload-on-conflict behavior.
Create a conversation only from an Active definition and pin the authoritative definition revision.
List, search, and keyset-page conversations without materializing unbounded transcripts.
Select a conversation and page its canonical transcript without displaying persisted System messages.
Rename and archive conversations with optimistic concurrency and stable user-visible conflict handling.
Keep system prompts available only in manage-scoped definition editor state, never in read-scoped transcript presentation.
Send each logical user turn with a stable operation id and the expected transcript revision.
Render the admitted user turn as a transient pending projection until authoritative transcript refresh.
Render coalesced llm.response.delta events as one transient Assistant message.
On terminal success, failure, cancellation, or recovery-required state, refresh authoritative operation and transcript state and remove transient projections.
Recover active operations after browser refresh, circuit reconnection, profile switch, and component remount without redispatch.
Create an application-wide conversation-shell boundary for unified floating catalog composition without moving product orchestration into presentation components.
Provide an Agent floating contributor that preserves context access filtering, affinity, history, lifecycle, and focused AgentChatPanel behavior.
Provide a Simple Chat floating contributor that never receives ambient project context automatically.
Offer All, Agents, and Chats filters over one available-participant catalog.
Keep participant kind and lifecycle axis separate: Available and Active are not substitutes for Agents and Chats.
Render focused windows through source-owned descriptors/components while the neutral shell owns overlay placement and catalog composition.
Keep hide/close-window, stop Agent handle, cancel LLM operation, and archive conversation as distinct declared actions.
Preserve all existing floating Agent catalog/window test ids, keyboard behavior, retention, close decisions, and context badges.
Support Simple Chat floating create/open/history/stream/cancel/reopen behavior using the same durable conversation and operation state as the main page.
Display only sanitized failures and never leak provider response bodies, secrets, system prompts, or internal request fingerprints.
Do not implement Add context, Project Structure, selected-node, subtree, file, or attachment context in this bundle.
Do not add tools, skills, Memory, voice, image/file attachments, approvals, or agent execution semantics to Simple Chats.
Do not add public chatbot channels, moderation, external participants, rate limits, or deployment fields to reusable definitions.
Select tests from each actual source diff with CodeAnalytics impacted_tests_get and reject zero or unexpected discovery.
Run at most one unfiltered Stable gate, only at the frozen final checkpoint after all affected checks pass.
Finish in awaiting-user-simple-chat-ui-verification state with a precise Agent and Simple Chat manual regression checklist.
